newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel FELS in US$60 mln China power jv.
newsitem.headline: Keppel FELS in US$60 mln China power jv.

text.p: Keppel FELS Ltd said on Thursday it has signed a joint-venture agreement to build a co-generation power plant in Hebei, China.
A company spokesman told Reuters the total value of the joint venture was around US$60 million, with Keppel FELS taking a 60 percent stake.
The remaining 40 percent stake is held by China partner Zunhua Energy Development Corporation.
Keppel FELS said in a statement the joint venture company will design, construct, commission and operate the 100 megawatt coal-fired plant in Zunhua City, north of China.
Under the power purchase agreement, the city has guaranteed to buy 63 percent of the plant's output for 20 years.
After this period, owernership of the plant will be transferred to Zunhua City.
Construction of the plant will take about 21 months.
This is Keppel FELS first co-generation plant project in China, the spokesman said.
Keppel FELS currently built, owns and operates power plants in the Philippines and Nicaragua, Central America.
